faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SGMH Delhi Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 14th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the post of Senior Resident, Dental (Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon) at Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MDS degree in Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery from a recognized University/Institution and have a valid registration with the Dental Council of India/Delhi Dental Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 67700 - 208700 per month, plus admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the SGMH Delhi Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Eligibility Screening, followed by a Screening/Written Test, and finally an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, and submit it along with required documents to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of SGMH Delhi. Links are provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Ad-hoc.
